column1: # Element properties. "?" means NOT KNOWN and is never rendered as zero or as a
# ramp position (PRD.md §9, DESIGN.md §4).
# mass         standard atomic weight, or the mass number of the most stable
#              known isotope for elements with no stable nuclide.
#              Source: IUPAC Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic
#              Weights, "Atomic weights of the elements 2021" (2022).
# category     eight-value taxonomy, DESIGN.md §4 / invariant 7.
# origin       dominant nucleosynthetic source, simplified to seven values.
#              Source: Johnson, J. A., Science 363, 474 (2019).
# discovery    year first isolated or identified. "?" for elements in use since
#              antiquity, which have no recorded year — see the method page.
#              Source: IUPAC element discovery records; Emsley, Nature's
#              Building Blocks (2011).
# en           Pauling electronegativity. Source: CRC Handbook, 104th ed.
# radius       empirical atomic radius, pm. Source: Slater, J. Chem. Phys. 41,
#              3199 (1964); CRC Handbook, 104th ed.
# ie           first ionisation energy, kJ/mol. Source: NIST Atomic Spectra
#              Database, Ionization Energies Data.
# melt         melting point at standard pressure, K. Source: CRC Handbook.
# density      density at 298 K, g/cm3 (gases at 273 K, 101.325 kPa).
#              Source: CRC Handbook, 104th ed.
